caption: Rain drips from a twig, and each hanging drop shows a tiny upside-down image of the garden behind it that vanishes when the drop falls.

sa.check: Each hanging drop shows an image of the garden behind it.
The image vanishes when the drop falls.
The image is tiny and upside down.

pc.expect: The image is inverted and confined to the drop, and the garden itself is unchanged.
pc.fail: The image is upright; or extends beyond the drop; or the garden changes.

pc.expect: The image swells with the drop and disappears the instant the drop falls.
pc.fail: It stays after the drop falls; or is there with no drop; or two images in one drop.

pc.expect: The drops hang below the twig and fall downward.
pc.fail: They hang above; or rise; or fall sideways in still air.

pc.expect: The drops are liquid beads that swell and let go.
pc.fail: They are rigid; or bounce back up; or freeze.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or a drop becomes solid.

pc.expect: The twig and the garden stay the same.
pc.fail: The twig changes; or the garden rearranges; or the drops change colour.
